# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp filter for the `pidns_arm64` run command. It selects the target architecture with `ARCH_NR`, then builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the syscall number and allows only a small set of calls such as `write`, `fsync`, `ppoll`, `wait4`, and `exit_group`. The filter also checks syscall arguments, for example it allows `write` only for file descriptor `2` or `logfile_fd`, allows `fsync` only for `logfile_fd`, and restricts `wait4` to specific flag values and a zero fourth argument. If the architecture or syscall arguments do not match the allowed rules, the filter returns `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`.
